fixture.unoriented_slope_convention: Primitive slopes (p,q) modulo simultaneous sign, q>0 or (1,0); equal traces retain every curve.

sensitivity_hypotheses.scope: fixed finite list; true-spectrum interpretation additionally requires completeness/no-entry
sensitivity_hypotheses.arithmetic: exact IEEE754 extraction, checked signed128 products, Python integer final fraction checks

all_point_convention: A(L)=2 sum floor(L/ell), signed positive multiples of unoriented primitive slopes; hyperbolic length units, not shortest-vector rescaling

raw_stream_layout.lengths.f64le: sorted IEEE754 little-endian binary64;8 bytes/curve; multiplicity retained
raw_stream_layout.slopes.i32le: two little-endian signed32 coordinates;8 bytes/curve; roots then sectors0,1,2, left-child-first DFS
raw_stream_layout.curves.i32-i32-f64le: moderate runs only: aligned little-endian int32 p,int32 q,binary64 length;16 bytes/curve
